name: Author
description: Compact byline that attributes content to any author: name, avatar (URL or path), optional profile link, and a localized or custom byline prefix; the fuller biography treatment is AuthorBio.

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Promoted from alpha: Example + ForcedColors stories present; Storybook axe gate enabled.

name.description: Author name shown after the byline prefix.

imageUrl.description: Avatar image source: a URL, an imported asset path, or static image data.

profileUrl.description: Optional author profile URL; makes the byline text a link.

bylinePrefix.description:
Byline prefix before the name. Defaults to the localized "By"
(fi "Kirjoittanut", sv "Av"), matching the native dt-author element.

forbiddenUse: Use Author for a full biography or social-link block; use AuthorBio instead.
Render an unlabelled avatar when the author's identity is not also available as text.
dense: Article byline: author name/avatar attribution line for blog posts

usage.description: Compact byline attribution (author identity) for blog posts. For the fuller end-of-article treatment use AuthorBio.

bestPractices.description: Place Author beside publication metadata near the article title.
Do not repeat a biography in the compact byline; compose AuthorBio later in the article.

anatomy.name: Avatar
anatomy.description: Visual author identity rendered by Avatar.

anatomy.name: Byline
anatomy.description: Text attribution, optionally linked to the author profile.
